description: This file defines a React functional component for an e-commerce shop page. It handles filtering, sorting, and displaying a list of products with various filters such as category, brand, price, and stock status.

methods.name: Shop
methods.description: React functional component representing the shop page with filtering and sorting capabilities.

methods.name: handleCategoryChange
methods.description: Updates the category filter state based on user selection.

methods.name: handleBrandChange
methods.description: Updates the brand filter state based on user selection.

methods.name: handleSortChange
methods.description: Updates the sorting criteria based on user selection.

methods.name: clearFilters
methods.description: Resets all filters to their default state.

methods.name: formatCategoryName
methods.description: Converts a slugified category string into a human-readable format.
